headline: Junior Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with experience in corporate communications, presentation design, and building reusable template libraries.

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding and visual identity, typography, layout, print production, marketing creative

skills.label: Workflow & Tools
skills.items: Notion, Miro, AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly)

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy, alongside typography, colour systems, layout, and visual hierarchy.
Utilized AI-assisted workflows including ChatGPT and Adobe Firefly for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Conducted usability testing and fed findings back into user flows and interface usability, alongside wireframing and prototyping.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Developed a complete branding kit including logo, typography, and palette, showcasing foundational design and asset organization skills.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her hands-on graphic design experience at Ascent, specifically highlighting corporate communications, presentation design, and building reusable template libraries, as well as foundational design work from her AT Creation experience.
omitted: Bounceless UX case study left out because this role is for a Junior Graphic Designer focusing on marketing assets and presentations, not B2B UX research.
